name: lark-feishu-ops
description: Fail-closed Lark CLI routing, trusted embedded guidance, and privacy-safe FeishuOps continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Fail-closed Lark CLI routing and private-safe continuity
interface.longDescription: Centralizes Feishu/Lark work behind a fail-closed dispatch policy: only explicitly allowlisted bounded reads may run directly, while unknown actions, side effects, auth/profile changes, raw OpenAPI, cross-domain work, and delegated follow-ups route through FeishuOps. Uses version-matched embedded lark-cli guidance, metadata-only continuity, multi-binary readiness checks, and complete installed-runtime parity diagnostics.
